title: John Handy and the uptown band with Andrew Morgan
summary: Williams played with John Handy for a long time and recalls Andrew Morgan and a guitarist at uptown spots.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Let's see, who else? What about John Handy? Did you ever work with him? John Handy?
I played with John Handy a long time.
You're trying to remember if he was in your band when I used to see him? No, I was in, I played. You and him?
He worked with me. He worked with a gang in my job. But I worked with him all his job. All his job.
I'm trying to remember who was at Thump and Manny's and the Lyon Centers and different places. Used to see you uptown. Andy. Andy? Howard. Sometimes Andrew Morgan too.
Andrew Morgan, Andrew Morgan worked up there a long time. Yeah.
Do you have a guitar or a piano or what?
Ghetto. Who was on a guitar? George Guino. Oh, yeah.
